purpose: Map CSW-01 through CSW-09 into additive implementation slices, owning domains, persistence boundaries, acceptance gates and rollback/compatibility behavior.

persistence_decision.rule: Creative-support records may be added under bounded D29 authoring workflow/provenance ownership; governed World/Adventure/Character/Campaign/A9/Asset payloads remain references to their owning domains.
persistence_decision.new_seam_rule: A new persistence seam requires later evidence that D29 cannot support the need without ownership violation or unacceptable coupling, plus separate governance/migration authority.

authority_dependencies.owns: creative-support durable records, authoring provenance, incorporation/proposal receipts
Adventure/Module definitions and Campaign run-local Adventure progression

implementation_slices.name: Creative identity lifecycle provenance foundation
implementation_slices.acceptance: Stable creative identity, lifecycle, ownership and provenance survive reload/recovery; no creative record is governed truth.
implementation_slices.rollback: Feature may be disabled without deleting compatible creative records.

implementation_slices.name: Creative Library Story Bible Project Memory
implementation_slices.persistence: D29 project/library/reference metadata; governed payloads referenced only
implementation_slices.acceptance: Authorization precedes search/count/topology and hidden/revoked references do not leak.
implementation_slices.rollback: Library organization remains stored; unavailable projections fail closed.

implementation_slices.name: Idea Inbox Inspiration Engine
implementation_slices.persistence: D29 saved ideas only; unsaved InspirationCandidate is ephemeral
implementation_slices.acceptance: Candidate generation never mutates seed automatically and no-AI path is complete.
implementation_slices.rollback: Saved ideas remain; optional generator/AI entry points may be disabled independently.

implementation_slices.name: Guided Creation Workflows Templates
implementation_slices.persistence: D29 workflow run state and creator answers; durable creative content remains CreativeFragment/project data
implementation_slices.acceptance: Skip/revisit/reorder/branch/freeform paths preserve creator control and workflow completion is pre-authoritative.
implementation_slices.rollback: Runs remain readable; creator content survives abandoned/disabled guidance.

implementation_slices.name: Narrative Design Lab Continuity Open Threads
implementation_slices.persistence: D29 narrative-plan/open-thread/candidate/disposition records; D28/A9 truth referenced only
implementation_slices.acceptance: All views share stable semantics; nonvisual topology parity; advisory analysis cannot rewrite truth; D28/A9 handoff explicit.
implementation_slices.rollback: Planning structures remain stored; analysis can be disabled without changing source material.

implementation_slices.name: Writing Studio Revision Workspace
implementation_slices.acceptance: Autosave/recovery is deterministic, revisions are creator-controlled and exact revision export is reproducible.
implementation_slices.rollback: Documents/revisions remain durable and exportable even if advanced editing assistance is disabled.

implementation_slices.name: Reuse Remix Transformation
implementation_slices.acceptance: Derivatives have independent identity/version, exact lineage and no silent source propagation or protected-context copy.
implementation_slices.rollback: Descendants remain independently editable; lineage remains inspectable.

implementation_slices.name: Creator Command Center APW Integration End-to-End Acceptance
implementation_slices.persistence: Mostly projections/resume metadata; no duplicate source truth
implementation_slices.acceptance: Returning creator resumes exact authorized work with authorization-before-aggregation, no hidden-count leakage and no coercive ranking.
implementation_slices.rollback: Source work remains accessible from owning screens even if Command Center is disabled.

incorporation_routes.operation: explicit propose/incorporate with source/target version receipt

stage_a_non_reopening.rule: CSW is additive successor implementation. A CSW defect does not invalidate predecessor completion evidence unless independent evidence demonstrates a predecessor regression.
stage_a_non_reopening.migration_rule: Never rewrite completed Stage A migrations; inspect current migration head and add only new additive migrations when implementation is activated.

internal_alpha_placement.recommendation: Activate CSW application slices only after remaining APW/APM planning handoffs resolve overlapping persistence/recovery/stage-integration decisions and governing application roadmap explicitly activates the implementation work.
